name: deepseek-supervisor
description: Evidence-based supervision: deterministic record rules and an explicitly configured side model no stronger than the worker; unknown identities use rules only.

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Explicit versioned side model ID. No default and no model fallback. Requires worker_model, model_relation and capability_profile.

review_changes.title: Review each turn's change
review_changes.description: At the end of a turn that changed code, the verifier also reads the change for a defect a command can show.

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: Exact worker ID reported by the host; aliases cannot establish the relationship.

model_relation.title: Model relationship
model_relation.description: same, side-no-stronger, or unverified. Unknown relationships run rules only.

capability_profile.title: Capability profile
capability_profile.description: Record identifying versions, reasoning configuration and measured relationship for this task distribution.

execution_mode.title: Independent execution
execution_mode.description: off by default. shadow runs isolated checks without feedback; enabled sends advisory findings. macOS only; unsupported workspaces remain read-only.
